characters.name: Maren Tsolo
characters.description: Tether-chief of the skimmer Patience, 41, bonded to the Halloran-Vey Combine from birth. Hard, wry and exact; runs the line that hauls the Bucket through Gall's cloud-tops. Leads the mutiny of 2391.

characters.name: Abel Tsolo
characters.description: Maren's younger brother, 29, a rigger on the Patience. Charming, quick, a gambler buried in debt; informs for the Company through Corwin Hale and carries the death of Lusine Arda.

characters.name: Ekene Adu
characters.description: Medic of the Patience, 52, Maren's lover. Gentle, stubborn, a pacifist who once worked as a contract medic at Tamsin's Rock after the Combine hushed it.

characters.name: Corwin Hale
characters.description: Chief warden of the Patience, a bonded trusty who keeps discipline for the Company. Big, patient, practical; the Company's informer-in-chief, and the man who will deal with whoever holds power.

characters.name: Aurelian Quist
characters.description: Halloran-Vey factor sent to close the Corva operation. Polished, tired, honest when cornered; has done this before and carries the Sanitation Agent as insurance.

characters.name: Lusine Arda
characters.description: Tether-runner and comms tech on the Patience, 24. Found out the Combine's closure plan; dies on the line in the first dip of the book.

characters.name: Odile Arda
characters.description: Lusine's younger sister, 19, a tether-runner. Fierce, fast, unforgiving; wants the person who cut her sister's line.

characters.name: Grandam Teska
characters.description: Oldest living dipper on the Patience, past eighty, blind in one eye. Keeper of the dippers' sayings: the Lamp takes the dead out and brings them back.

characters.name: Severin Lachance
characters.description: Captain of the Combine escort cutter Admonition. Courteous, unhurried, without mercy or malice.

characters.name: Danek Sorell
characters.description: Rigger on Maren's line crew, big-handed, a singer. Goes into the Clement's collar first on the night of the mutiny.

characters.name: Bram Kovac
characters.description: One of Hale's trusties, a hard young man with a shock-stick and no doubts.

characters.name: Marta Oyelowo
characters.description: Sergeant of the six Combine marines aboard the Clement. A professional; guards the cold hold.

characters.name: Isaura Venn
characters.description: Air-warden of the city of Patience, 31, unshared by birth. Reads meters and cuts the air of tithe-defaulters; good at a cruel job, and tells herself it keeps people alive. Narrates the siege.

characters.name: Ama Venn
characters.description: Isaura's mother, sixties, with the ice cough of the Ninth Tier. A quiet Lamper who mends filters for a living.

characters.name: Malachy Orr
characters.description: Archivist of the Spine, seventies, once Isaura's schoolmaster. Dry, frail, dangerous with a fact.

characters.name: Lucan Strand
characters.description: First Shareholder of Patience, head of the oldest shared family. Silver-voiced, sincere about his city and about who it belongs to.

characters.name: Corin Strand
characters.description: Lucan's son, 28, the best dipper-pilot in the city. Brave, proud, raised on the Purchase; flies the Lamp Run.

characters.name: Mattias Ebb
characters.description: Concord lieutenant shot down over Kettle and taken prisoner. A conscript bonded for his family's debt; dry, frightened, decent.

characters.name: Anselm Grieve
characters.description: Commodore of the Concord of Vey fleet besieging Kettle. Patient, legalistic, under orders he would rather not show anyone.

characters.name: Dasha Imre
characters.description: Rigger and Lamper from the lower warrens, 40s, tattooed with comet-tails. Crews the Lamp Run.

characters.name: Pilar Ocampo
characters.description: Nine-year-old girl of the Ninth Tier whose family's air Isaura cuts.

characters.name: Til Brask
characters.description: Captain of the salvage tug Dray, 44, ex-convict, in debt to everyone. Sardonic, practical, a woman who always takes the deal; carries the death of her sister.

characters.name: Juno Brask
characters.description: Til's niece, 17, bonded clerk in Mother Szabo's counting-house on her dead mother's debt. Sharp, furious, braver than she knows.

characters.name: Ozias Mbeki
characters.description: Engineer of the Dray, sixties, Til's oldest friend. A Roundsman who believes what goes out comes back; gentle hands, filthy jokes.

characters.name: Hollis Vey
characters.description: The last of the Vey line, dying, carried in a medical cradle. Hires the Dray to reach the Lamp before it breaks; knows more than he says.

characters.name: Cato Marchetti
characters.description: Hollis Vey's agent and bodyguard. Courteous, scarred, very still.

characters.name: Ilona Szabo
characters.description: Debt-broker of Cinderhaven, who holds Til's paper and Juno's bond. Captain-owner of the Carrion Hymn.

characters.name: Mags Brask
characters.description: Til's elder sister and Juno's mother, a salvager who died on the Harrow job eleven years before the story.
